svg.font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono','Liberation Mono','Noto Sans Mono CJK SC',monospace
svg.text: Rockchip Disk Partition Layouts — Seeed Armbian OTA
4 build profiles (Recovery / A/B × Plain / Secure) · fixed pre-GPT region · GPT partitions from OFFSET=16 MiB
raw areas below the GPT — addressed by sector, not by partition

g.text: secure: RSA sign, pubkey → SPL dtb
A/B mode additionally writes slot state here — see ④

svg.text: ROM → idbloader → SPL (pubkey baked) → u-boot.itb → boot.itb (in p1)
ENV is CRC32-only — never signed; SPL/U-Boot are signed; kernel FIT is signed

g.text: ./build.sh recovery — single system · boot is ext4 files · no encryption
boot policy: trust files on ext4
./build.sh ab — two complete systems · dual boot+rootfs slots · no encryption
./build.sh recovery secure-boot — p1 becomes a signed raw FIT partition · no /boot filesystem · LUKS rootfs+userdata
written by dd at build time
nothing on p1 can be edited at runtime
overlay change → re-sign FIT → dd p1
./build.sh ab secure-boot — two raw FIT slots · dual rootfs · shared keybox+userdata · ENV carries slot state
ab_preboot=…retry logic, rolls back when exhausted…
U-Boot reads ENV, picks slot, calls boot_fit on the raw FIT partition,
verifies RSA-PSS, jumps into kernel — no ext4 driver, no /boot filesystem.
Plain profiles (①②) carry only bootcmd + armbian.bootdev token here.
sector 8128 U-Boot ENV (32 KiB, CRC32, pre-filled at build)
p1..p6 GPT partitions from OFFSET=16 MiB
boot.itb kernel FIT inside p1 (③) or p1+p2 (④) — distinct from u-boot.itb
ENV vars (A/B only): boot_slot · boot_success · ota_in_progress · retry budget
ENV vars (all): bootcmd with armbian.bootdev=… / armbian.bootdevnum=…
FIT content: kernel + dtb (overlays baked) + initrd + RSA-PSS signature
Verification: SPL pubkey (in dtb) → u-boot.itb → boot.itb → LUKS unlock
OTA never touches: userdata, security, ENV (only runtime slot flips)
